sources.title: ONS Energy Performance Building Certificates weekly dataset
facts: Weekly EPC counts cover new and existing domestic properties in England and Wales.
Certificate counts and ratings are building-energy evidence, not direct parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: ONS Environment climate and nature insights UK 2026
facts: ONS reports household activities, especially travel and home heating, as a major residence-basis GHG source.
National household shares cannot be assigned directly to individual properties or parcels.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts 2026
facts: ONS reports residence-basis greenhouse-gas emissions by households and industries.
Residence-basis industry and household aggregates are not territorial parcel observations.

sources.title: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions methodology
facts: ONS distinguishes territorial, residence and footprint greenhouse-gas measures.
Accounting bases must remain distinct and cannot be silently mixed for parcel inference.

sources.title: Household Energy Efficiency Statistics headline release June 2026
facts: DESNZ reports ECO and Green Deal measures, costs and estimated carbon and energy savings.
Estimated scheme savings are not direct measured emissions for a property or parcel.

sources.title: Household Energy Efficiency Statistics collection
facts: The collection links monthly and annual ECO, Green Deal and insulation statistics.
Collection provenance and scheme delivery do not prove physical parcel emissions.

sources.title: Household Energy Efficiency Statistics detailed report 2025
facts: The annual report covers ECO, Green Deal, insulation levels, costs and estimated carbon and energy savings through 2025.
Estimated savings and insulation levels require explicit property binding before any parcel use.

sources.title: Office for Statistics Regulation review of Energy Performance of Buildings Certificates
facts: OSR reviews trustworthiness, quality and value of EPC and DEC official statistics.
A quality review establishes statistical governance, not physical emissions measurements.

sources.title: Live tables on Energy Performance of Buildings Certificates
facts: Live EPC tables include ratings, modelled energy use, carbon dioxide emissions, fuel costs and floor area.
EPC outputs are model-based certificate attributes and must not be treated as directly metered parcel emissions.

sources.title: Energy Performance of Buildings Certificates January to March 2026 statistical release
facts: The release reports EPC lodgements and energy-efficiency bands for England and Wales.
Counts and bands are certificate statistics rather than direct emissions observations.

sources.title: Energy efficiency characteristics of new dwellings
facts: MHCLG reports new-dwelling heating systems and energy-efficiency characteristics from EPC data.
Heat-pump or solar-PV presence is a property characteristic, not a measured emissions amount.

sources.title: National Energy Efficiency Data-Framework consumption data tables 2026
facts: NEED provides gas and electricity consumption statistics by property and household characteristics and local authority.
Consumption statistics require supported emissions factors and period alignment before emissions calculation.

sources.title: Heat pump deployment statistics March 2026
facts: DESNZ monitors UK hydronic heat-pump installations up to 45kW.
Installation counts do not directly quantify operational or avoided greenhouse-gas emissions.

sources.title: Heat Pump Deployment statistics collection
facts: The collection provides quarterly heat-pump deployment counts and notes provisional revisions.
Deployment statistics are technology adoption evidence rather than parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: Heat pump deployment National Data Library
facts: The National Data Library exposes official heat-pump deployment resources and licence metadata.
Catalogue records provide provenance but no new direct parcel-emissions observation.

sources.title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme statistics May 2026
facts: DESNZ reports BUS voucher applications, redemptions and installation costs.
Voucher or grant activity is administrative evidence and not physical greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme statistics collection
facts: The BUS collection monitors uptake of low-carbon heating technologies in England and Wales.
Scheme uptake must not be converted directly into parcel emissions or savings without an explicit method.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS monthly scheme update
facts: Ofgem reports BUS applications, vouchers, redemptions, grants and budget through June 2026.
Scheme administration values and money flows are not physical emissions measurements.

sources.title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme National Data Library
facts: The catalogue exposes official BUS monthly data files and licence metadata.
Catalogue and voucher data require separate physical-performance evidence for emissions inference.

sources.title: Great British Insulation Scheme release June 2026
facts: DESNZ reports GBIS installed measures and upgraded households with provisional Ofgem data.
Measure installation counts are not direct greenhouse-gas observations.

sources.title: Summary of the Great British Insulation Scheme June 2026
facts: The summary records GBIS delivery, household characteristics and scheme costs to March 2026.
Scheme delivery and cost statistics do not establish measured property emissions.

sources.title: Great British Insulation Scheme collection
facts: The collection records GBIS releases and notes continuing provisional revisions.
Release scheduling and scheme status are provenance evidence, not emissions observations.

sources.title: Great British Insulation Scheme National Data Library
facts: The catalogue links GBIS data resources and identifies source transitions from TrustMark to Ofgem.
Source-system metadata must be preserved when comparing revisions and does not itself measure emissions.

sources.title: Warm Homes Social Housing Fund statistics June 2026
facts: DESNZ reports measures installed and homes upgraded under the Warm Homes Social Housing Fund in England.
Scheme delivery counts are retrofit activity, not measured greenhouse-gas emissions.

sources.title: Social Housing Decarbonisation Fund statistics collection
facts: The collection tracks SHDF energy-efficiency measures and upgraded homes in England.
Programme delivery statistics are not direct emissions observations.

sources.title: Summary of the Social Housing Decarbonisation Fund statistics June 2026
facts: The summary reports measures, homes upgraded and EPC-band improvements across SHDF waves.
EPC improvement and measure counts do not equal directly measured carbon savings.

sources.title: Social Housing Decarbonisation Fund National Data Library
facts: The catalogue exposes SHDF monthly data resources and Open Government Licence metadata.
Catalogue rows provide provenance rather than direct parcel emissions.

sources.title: Industrial Energy Transformation Fund benefits
facts: DESNZ reports IETF funding, applicant information and expected emissions and energy savings.
Application-stage expected benefits are estimates and must not be promoted to observed emissions reductions.

sources.title: Industrial Energy Transformation Fund collection
facts: The collection records IETF phases, evaluations and competition winners and notes the fund closed to new extension in 2025.
Programme status and funding do not themselves establish physical emissions reductions.

sources.title: Industrial Energy Transformation Fund interim impact evaluation
facts: The evaluation uses programme monitoring, beneficiary, applicant and stakeholder evidence with quantitative benefits analysis.
Evaluation estimates and contribution claims must remain distinct from direct site emissions measurements.

sources.title: Industrial Energy Transformation Fund final process evaluation
facts: The process evaluation uses surveys, interviews and documentation for IETF Phases 1 and 2.
Process evidence evaluates programme delivery and is not a direct emissions dataset.

sources.title: Updating evidence on energy efficiency potential for UK industry
facts: DESNZ research updates evidence on industrial energy-efficiency potential and process-level decarbonisation levers.
Technical potential is scenario/research evidence and not observed facility emissions reduction.

sources.title: Ofwat PR24 final determinations performance commitment definitions
facts: Ofwat performance commitments include operational greenhouse-gas reporting for water and wastewater and recognised assurance standards.
Assured company-level operational GHG reporting is not automatically attributable to a cadastral parcel.
